item.text:
`orders.js` provides order helpers: totals line items, applies two discount codes, calculates an average, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:
- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`, so its last iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (`undefined`) and throws on every non-empty order (and on empty arrays too).
- `averageItemPrice` divides a quantity-weighted total by the number of line items; if “item” means individual units, it should divide by total quantity. It also returns `NaN` for an empty array.
